a=pd.read_csv('demo_metadata.csv',index_col=0); b=pd.read_csv('/tmp/out_test/demo_metadata.csv',index_col=0)

print('overlap px',(cnt>1).sum(),'bad',bad)
cv2.imwrite('/tmp/vis.png',cv2.resize(vis,None,fx=2,fy=2,interpolation=cv2.INTER_NEAREST))
